text:
maya: Heads up — deploy-bot is stuck promoting build 9204 to canary, status shows cache-lease stamp drift / lease conflict at 13:12 PT. https://ci.example.com/builds/9204
li: saw it. logs: promotion failed when remote cache verify returned mismatched stamp for artifact index. snippet:
```
VERIFY index: expected-stamp=2026-03-23T13:00:00Z, found-stamp=2026-03-23T12:48:27Z
error: cache lease conflict: lease_id mismatch
```
deploy-bot: auto-retry suspended after 4 attempts. promotion_state=PAUSED, reason="cache_lease_stamp_drift". suggestion: manual-intervention or reupload artifact index.
henry: change window is 13:30 PT. product demo at 13:45. if we wait for cache reconciliation, risk missing window. options: pin previous canary sha256:88ff22, or force promote with --ignore-cache-check (risky).
sre-oncall: storage team reports a rolling cache metadata compaction that rewrote index timestamps for a subset of shards; integrity checks pass but stamps don't align, so verify fails. short-term safe path is pin previous digest for canary.
marco: if we force promote we might serve older artifacts to some nodes due to stale cache; that could cause client errors. not recommended for demo.
li: we should quarantine 9204, promote sha256:88ff22 for the window, and schedule a controlled reupload of 9204's index after storage finishes reconciliation. also capture audit note for postmortem.
maya: agree. @deploy-bot promote sha256:88ff22 to canary and tag 9204 quarantine. include reason: "cache lease stamp drift".
deploy-bot: received manual promote command. running: `deploybot promote --env canary --image sha256:88ff22 --reason "cache_lease_stamp_drift build 9204"`
deploy-bot: promote succeeded, canary now on sha256:88ff22, routing updated. promotion_log: /deploy/logs/3427779999/promote-88ff22
ci-bot: auto-schedule: reverify build 9204 artifacts when storage marks index reconciled. will post update.
henry: tess (release notes owner) — please add entry: "Canary pinned to sha256:88ff22 due to cache index stamp drift on 9204; build quarantined". cc PMs.
marco: storage-oncall will run a deterministic replay to normalize stamps and then we'll retry promote after integrity confirm.
sre-oncall: opening follow-up: INC-8492, assigning to storage team for root cause & remediation.
maya: marking change-window met. if any drift recurrence in next 6h, escalate to infra pager. thanks team. :thumbsup:
